name: A 305-Concept Adjacent-Clause Endpoint Switch
definition: Let $S=B_0\cup\{604\}$, take the completed four-cube $C=Q_I\times\{28\}$ on support $I$ of bitmask $1632$, and add a fresh coordinate $f$ of bitmask $4096$. Form $R=(S\times\{0\})\cup(C\times\{1\})$ and, for each admissible trace, delete its corresponding vertex of the full $J=I\cup\{f\}$ slice.
parameters: The common completion $R$ has 306 concepts. Its twenty admissible omissions have 305 concepts, dimension thirteen, and VC dimension four.
properties: The root-retaining admissible-trace graph is connected. All sixteen upper omissions peel to zero; among the four lower omissions only trace $576$ fails. Adjacent traces $576$ and $4672$ delete vertices $604$ and $4700$ and have opposite endpoint status. The negative member contains the proper rooted face $B_0$ and is therefore not itself a rooted factor.
